title: Compiling Specialized GPU-Initiated Networking
abstract: arXiv:2611.18145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning systems specialize computation to the workload and hardware, but communication remains in generic libraries whose device code and transport decisions are not visible to high-level compilers. We present Obaleth, a compiler that makes GPU-initiated communication part of a kernel's intermediate representation, co-optimizes it alongside computation, and lowers it to specialized transport code. Obaleth plans completions around buffer lifetimes and optimizes memory ordering, synchronization, and batching across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. On H100 GPUs, Obaleth sends small messages up to 3.3$\times$ faster, and on 256 GPUs runs all-to-all 1.25$\times$ and 2.3$\times$ faster than NVSHMEM and NCCL GIN, with much smaller memory and register use. In vLLM, it serves Qwen3-235B on 16 B200 GPUs and answers requests up to 1.29$\times$ faster than with DeepEP.

translated_title: 编译专用化的GPU发起网络通信
translated_abstract: 机器学习系统能够针对工作负载和硬件对计算进行专门化优化，但通信部分仍停留在通用库中，其设备代码和传输决策对高级编译器不可见。我们提出了Obaleth，一个将GPU发起的通信纳入内核中间表示的编译器，它将通信与计算共同优化，并将其降低为专门的传输代码。Obaleth围绕缓冲区生命周期规划完成操作，并在NVIDIA和AMD GPU上优化内存排序、同步和批处理。在H100 GPU上，Obaleth发送小消息的速度最高提升3.3倍；在256个GPU上，其all-to-all通信比NVSHMEM和NCCL GIN分别快1.25倍和2.3倍，且内存和寄存器占用显著更小。在vLLM中，它在16个B200 GPU上服务Qwen3-235B模型，响应请求的速度比使用DeepEP最高快1.29倍。
tldr: Obaleth编译器将GPU发起的通信纳入内核中间表示并与计算协同优化，生成专门的传输代码，在小消息发送、大规模all-to-all通信和大模型推理服务中显著超越NVSHMEM、NCCL GIN和DeepEP等通用通信库。
en_tdlr: Obaleth is a compiler that embeds GPU-initiated communication into a kernel's intermediate representation, co-optimizes it with computation, and lowers it to specialized transport code, achieving up to 3.3× faster small-message sends and outperforming NVSHMEM, NCCL GIN, and DeepEP in large-scale all-to-all communication and LLM serving.
